title: Korean Face Solo #24 (한국 · 30대 · 고혹적인 · 메이크업 글래스 스킨 2단계 · 보통 · 스티커 야광 별 · 각도 3/4 회전(오른쪽) · 점 눈물점+입술점)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head turned about forty-five degrees to her right in a three-quarter view, her eyes still looking straight into the camera, one ear and the turned cheek clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Korean woman — Korean poised refined beauty luminous fair porcelain complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and clear glass-skin glow, mid 30s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, long glossy dark-brown waves swept to one side. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, a small dark beauty mark just below the outer corner of her left eye like a tear mole, a second tiny beauty mark above the right corner of her upper lip, each one a clearly visible dot of real skin pigment, dewy skin with a light highlighter on the cheekbones, a soft peach blush, juicy peach-tinted lips, three small glow-in-the-dark star stickers on the cheekbone, softly glowing neon green-blue against the dark, all stickers flat on the skin, clear of the eyes and lids, a slow, lingering gaze, lips closed in a restrained knowing half-smile, an alluring, mature, magnetic expression — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
